tools.name: dp_commercial_get_company_profile
tools.description: Return the verified legal identity, corporate contacts, and evidence URLs for DigitalPublic.

tools.name: dp_commercial_ask_navigator
tools.description: Match a prospective need with public DigitalPublic capabilities, illustrative use cases and plans. It has no access to customer projects or private data.

tools.name: dp_commercial_get_capability_matrix
tools.description: List read, preparation, supervised-write, approval, plan, and module capabilities with explicit qualifications.

tools.name: dp_commercial_get_data_processing_profile
tools.description: Explain controller and processor roles, public AI training policy, private customer data exclusions, controls, DPA, privacy, and subprocessor evidence URLs.

tools.name: dp_commercial_compare_integration_options
tools.description: Provide an objective comparison of direct provider MCP servers and DigitalPublic across setup, governance, cross-channel work, and tradeoffs.

tools.name: dp_commercial_estimate_roi
tools.description: Calculate only the value of entered time savings, plan cost, net value, and break-even hours. It never forecasts sales or advertising performance.

tools.name: dp_commercial_list_use_cases
tools.description: List clearly labeled illustrative use cases without presenting them as customer results or performance claims.

tools.name: dp_commercial_get_service_status
tools.description: Return the current component health and timestamp. Status is measured by an independent monitor hosted outside the platform. Components with no recent evidence are reported as 'unknown' — never assume 'unknown' means healthy. Does not invent uptime history or an SLA.

tools.name: dp_commercial_get_uptime_history
tools.description: Return historical uptime for a component, always alongside its data coverage. A high uptime with low coverage is not meaningful, so both values must be reported together. Returns 'insufficient_data' when coverage is too low to publish a figure. DigitalPublic publishes no contractual SLA.

tools.name: dp_commercial_start_live_trial
tools.description: Start an idempotent 14-day trial with up to three active real projects, 2,000 total units, up to five connected tools and supervised write access. Sensitive actions still require human approval. A single passwordless email verifies identity, establishes the portal session and resumes provisioning. K

tools.name: dp_commercial_get_live_trial_status
tools.description: Resume a trial using its limited status token. Returns stable state and nextAction, remaining days, units and connection capacity, plus only safe human links. It never returns email, provider tokens, OAuth URLs, or provider payloads.

tools.name: dp_commercial_get_install_options
tools.description: Return publication-aware installation options for the authenticated DigitalPublic operational product in OpenAI, Claude Code, and generic MCP clients. Directory URLs remain null until publication is explicitly enabled.

tools.name: dp_commercial_get_onboarding_guide
tools.description: Return the goal-oriented sequence an agent should follow, including every mandatory human checkpoint and the handoff from DigitalPublic Commercial to DigitalPublic.

tools.name: dp_commercial_describe_platform
tools.description: Explain what DigitalPublic does for humans and AI agents.

tools.name: dp_commercial_list_offers
tools.description: List current plans, EUR and USD prices, limits, seats, modules, and checkout mode.

tools.name: dp_commercial_get_offer
tools.description: Return one current plan by id.

tools.name: dp_commercial_compare_offers
tools.description: Compare two or more plans using the canonical catalog.

tools.name: dp_commercial_assess_fit
tools.description: Recommend a plan from project count, team size, live-data need, distributor status, and write requirement.

tools.name: dp_commercial_list_integrations
tools.description: List integrations included in commercial V1. Use trialChannels, not the connector id, as channels for dp_commercial_start_live_trial.

tools.name: dp_commercial_get_connection_requirements
tools.description: Explain authentication modes, scopes, human prerequisites, review state and known limitations for one DigitalPublic connector.

tools.name: dp_commercial_get_security_profile
tools.description: Explain project isolation, scopes, approvals, token revocation, and audit controls.

tools.name: dp_commercial_get_checkout_readiness
tools.description: Report whether the real trial, self-service checkout, and Enterprise proposal onboarding are currently available.

tools.name: dp_commercial_get_sample_report
tools.description: Return an illustrative synthetic report sample without customer data. This is not a service trial and must never be represented as measured customer performance.

tools.name: dp_commercial_start_checkout
tools.description: Compatibility checkout for paid plans and Enterprise proposals. Use dp_commercial_start_live_trial for evaluation. A human must verify email and complete any payment.

tools.name: dp_commercial_get_checkout_status
tools.description: Return the non-sensitive status of a historical checkout or proposal request. For the real trial use dp_commercial_get_live_trial_status.

tools.name: dp_commercial_claim_credentials
tools.description: Legacy credential claim for still-valid historical paid checkout intents. Live trials never deliver an operational credential in chat; install DigitalPublic and use project OAuth instead.

tools.name: dp_commercial_request_proposal
tools.description: Request an email-verified Enterprise proposal. This does not create a contract or charge.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "dp_commercial_start_live_trial" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-commercial" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dp_commercial_get_company_profile, dp_commercial_get_data_processing_profile, dp_commercial_get_live_trial_status, dp_commercial_get_install_options, dp_commercial_get_connection_requirements · Private data: dp_commercial_get_company_profile, dp_commercial_ask_navigator, dp_commercial_get_data_processing_profile, dp_commercial_get_live_trial_status, dp_commercial_get_security_profile, dp_commercial_claim_credentials · Public sink: dp_commercial_get_uptime_history, dp_commercial_start_live_trial, dp_commercial_get_live_trial_status, dp_commercial_start_checkout, dp_commercial_request_proposal.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dp_commercial_get_company_profile, dp_commercial_get_data_processing_profile, dp_commercial_get_live_trial_status, dp_commercial_get_install_options, dp_commercial_get_connection_requirements · Private data: dp_commercial_get_company_profile, dp_commercial_ask_navigator, dp_commercial_get_data_processing_profile, dp_commercial_get_live_trial_status, dp_commercial_get_security_profile, dp_commercial_claim_credentials · Public sink: dp_commercial_get_uptime_history, dp_commercial_start_live_trial, dp_commercial_get_live_trial_status, dp_commercial_start_checkout, dp_commercial_request_proposal

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
